Name: Green Farm Cave
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

I am happy to present my Green Farm Cave, I know it is another Farm Cave, but this is my masterpiece, I finally got good with maps and I am starting to work on creating the ideal small farm as well.
Here you can plant like in a greenhouse and crops could become giant, you can fill watering can, you can enter the pool and recharge your energy, you can put pots that collect river forage, you can catch fish, you can also put barrels to age like in a cellar and a convenient minecart.
You can choose whether you want it without quarry, without swimming, without quarry and swimming, or with quarry and swimming. The default setting is with quarry and swimming configurable via GMCM.

Now everything works with version 1.6
Version 1.1.5 Translations in many languages have been added to GMCM, created by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/KasualTheGamer]KasualTheGamer[/url].
Translation into English, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Chinese.
If your language is not listed, feel free to publish the translation file only here on Nexus, linking to my mod as a dependency, or send me the translation and I will add it.

Installation:
Unzip and paste into Stardew Valley Mods folder.

[color=#00ffff][size=3]Now you can change the type of cave directly ingame via GMCM, Just enter the cave and choose the one you prefer.[/size][/color]

Hey people! I had to make an aesthetic improvement to our dear Farm Cave and its phenomenal  cosmic powers, when I saw the ConcernedApe waterfalls I couldn't resist and I thought that this cannot be missing from my Farm Cave and so here it is, even if it cost me becoming hydrophobic to put it, I admit that ConcernedApe must care a lot about his game and as a map creator I understand that someone who creates a waterfall so maniacally amazes me, but also makes me understand that he didn't create it for money but he really loves his game, perhaps this is precisely the reason why people like it so much, it deserves its success!
I thank [u]ConcernedApe[/u] for this wonderful game, [u]Pathoschild[/u] for creating SMAPI which allows us to enjoy all the mods, I would also like to thank all the mod creators in general, considering that I play with many beautiful mods.I'm new to the world of modding, but I really like doing it and I do it with passion, I also like others to have fun and above all the mods I create to play them too so I want them to be enjoyable.I hope everyone likes the improvement, I also added the update key, so you won't miss future updates. Thanks everyone and have fun!

[color=#00ff00][size=4]Hi folks, I've recolored both versions of this awesome Green Farm Cave![/size][/color]
